items.reason: Build/script tooling dependency (glob > minimatch). No user input reaches minimatch in production runtime. Upgrade to minimatch@10.2.3 pending upstream glob release. Risk confined to local/CI tooling DoS only.
items.exposure_in_staging_only_pilot: Not on staging HTTP request path for Union Eyes pilot surfaces; build/script/CI tooling only.
items.mitigation_or_compensating_control: No user-controlled glob/minimatch input in staging app runtime; pilot uses synthetic fixtures; staging-only envelope.
items.residual_risk: Local/CI tooling ReDoS only if attacker controls glob patterns in build environment — outside pilot blast radius.

items.reason: Transitive dependency of swagger-ui-react (internal API docs only). immutable@3.x has no npm fix; v4 upgrade is a breaking API change that breaks swagger-ui-react rendering. No user-controlled data flows through affected APIs. Mitigated by internal-only access and no untrusted merge input.
items.exposure_in_staging_only_pilot: swagger-ui-react transitive; internal API docs UI if enabled — not required for bounded Phase H pilot HTTP matrix surfaces.
items.mitigation_or_compensating_control: Internal docs-only usage; no untrusted merge input; staging-only; ORGS<=2 curated.
items.residual_risk: Prototype pollution if untrusted data fed to immutable merge APIs in swagger-ui — not exercised by pilot grant/deny matrix.

items.source: CI pnpm audit / Dependency Audit on head 72c1125190b790a5b6f43def739f846cf1cdb726 (jobs 107334222501, 107334220319); audit-level=high found 1 high, 0 critical; totalVulns=4 (also LOW esbuild 1120680, MODERATE vitest 1193683, MODERATE adm-zip symlink 1193734 — moderate/low NOT enumerated as pilot blockers).
items.completeness: COMPLETE for high/critical on this PR head via CI logs 2026-09-23; did not re-run local pnpm audit; did not download artifact zip contents (log summary sufficient).
items.exposure_in_staging_only_pilot: adm-zip typically used for archive extraction in tooling/import paths. Phase H pilot surfaces exercised (org, grievances, documents repository get/download, external specialist grant/deny) do not require user-upload zip inflate as a proven path. Exact runtime reachability in staging UE tip image not fully proven here.
items.mitigation_or_compensating_control: Staging-only; curated users; no broad untrusted zip upload in pilot envelope; kill criteria include auth bypass / sustained 500s; ACA prior revision + PG15 snapshot restore available.
items.residual_risk: If a pilot feature path extracts attacker-controlled zip with malicious declared sizes, memory DoS on the container is possible until patched/waived.
